scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: node -e "process.platform==='linux' && require('child_process').execSync('npm install --no-save --prefix frontend @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu', {stdio:'inherit'})" && npm run build --workspace frontend && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true})"
